messages:
Kai: Heads-up — we need to reserve GPU capacity for the new eu-central cluster bring-up next week. Target: 40 A100s in eu-central1 for initial bake. Who's on quota request and cost sign-off?
Maya: I can take quota request. Do we want GCP regional or zonal reservation?
Ravi: Prefer regional quota (eu-central1) with a preferred-zone hint (europe-west3-a) so autoscaler has flex. Also request GPUs as 'acceleratorCounts' not specific VM types.
Maya: Copy. Drafting ticket now. Will need the following: project id, machine families, accelerators, GCE quota increases (GPUS, CPUs), and a T-shirt cost estimate for finance.
Kai: Project id: infra-redwood-eu. Machine family: n1-standard fallback + n2-highmem for perf. GPU type: a100-40gb. Count: 40. Expected baseline CPU quota: +320 vCPUs.
Ravi: Add a note: we'll bring up a single node pool initially, then scale to multiple node pools after warmup. Autoscale target latency SLO for perf tests is 50ms token p95 — include that in justification.
Maya: ops-bot: create-cloud-quota-ticket project=infra-redwood-eu region=eu-central1 gpus=40 vcpus=320 note="inference cluster bring-up + perf validation, SLOs attached"
ops-bot: Created ticket GCP-12487 and notified cloud-provider-support. ETA for approval: 3-5 business days. Link: https://cloudsupport.example/GCP-12487 :white_check_mark:
Avery: FYI finance needs a monthly $ estimate before we commit. Quick calc: 40 A100s reserved at list -> ~$75k/mo (pre-discount). I'll open a Finance request for committed commit.
finance-pager: Opened FIN-5673 for committed capacity approval. Please attach the expected burn rate and the pros/cons of on-demand vs reserved.
Kai: For procurement note: we plan a 2-week reservation window for bring-up and stress, then convert to dedicated reserved pool if burn looks healthy. That minimizes upfront commit.
Maya: Copy. Draft text for quota request I used: "We request a regional GPU quota increase in eu-central1 to support a short-term cluster bring-up. Details: project infra-redwood-eu, GPU type a100-40gb, quantity 40, CPU quota +320, reason: production inference validation and warm traffic testing. Timeline: 14 days initial reservation. Performance SLOs attached in ticket. Contact: maya@redwood.ai"
Ravi: Suggest adding network egress warning: we'll need 100Gbps inter-node for sharded KV/cache; include expected network egress and NAT IP count. Cloud sometimes asks about external egress.
Maya: Added: expected inter-node throughput ~80-120Gbps, NAT IPs: 8.
Kai: Operational checklist for bring-up (quick bullets):
- Confirm GCP quota approval (GCP-12487)
- Reserve ephemeral capacity in capacity planner (internal) with reservation id RES-EU-2301
- Terraform node-pool module set to initial_replicas=4, autoscaler min=1 max=50
- IAM: service account infra-inference-sa has roles/compute.instanceAdmin and roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
- Network: ensure firewall rd-kv and redis rules open on internal CIDR only; disable public ssh except jumpbox
- Validation: run smoke-run.sh (nvidia-smi, cuda-memtest, small LLM perf run)
Maya: I'll attach Terraform snippet in the ticket and paste the quota request content for the provider.
Ravi: Validation commands I'll run once nodes are up:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide
ssh jumpbox@bastion -- sudo nvidia-smi
./bench/run_inference_bench --model redwood/llama-16b --seq 512 --tokens 1000 --concurrency 8
```
Avery: For cost control during bring-up, enable preemption protection off (i.e., prefer preemptible for non-critical tests) until we hit perf validation. That can halve costs during soak.
finance-pager: Note: preemptible savings acknowledged. FIN-5673 needs a short memo if we later convert to reserved.
Maya: Cloud support replied: provisional quota approved for 14 days pending verification, GCP-12487 status: APPROVED_TEMP. They asked for a verification window start timestamp.
Kai: Start window: 1764620000 (next Tue 06:00 UTC). Reply with that and ask for extension path.
Maya: Done — replied with start timestamp and asked for extension SLA. ops-bot: updated ticket GCP-12487 with start_ts=1764620000
ops-bot: GCP-12487 updated by Maya.
Ravi: Handoff notes for on-call/eng-sre: if node provisioning stalls >30m check quota limit via `gcloud compute regions describe eu-central1 --project=infra-redwood-eu` and confirm GPUsRemaining > 0. If 403 from API, escalate to cloud support with GCP-12487.
Kai: Also: post-approval we must stamp capacity in our internal capacity planner: RES-EU-2301 -> status=allocated. Maya update after deploy.
Maya: After bring-up complete I'll post a short runbook snippet in eng-infra pinned message with: terraform plan, apply, smoke commands, and handoff checklist.
Avery: One more ops tip — set node affinity for gpu nodes taint gpu=true:NoSchedule so non-inference pods don't land. Also add a ttl controller for ephemeral test jobs so they don't leak.
Ravi: Affirmative. I'll create the k8s taint/affinity PR and add the ttl cleanup.
Kai: Thanks all. If GCP extends beyond 14d we'll move to reserved capacity negotiation (contact sales). Keep this thread updated with ticket statuses. :rocket:
Maya: Will do. Closing for now but will update when nodes are green.
ops-bot: Thread archived to eng-infra after 24h of inactivity.
